metadata.title: Broadcom Stock Falls on Report Google is Cutting AI Chip Shipments<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Broadcom Stock Falls on Report Google is Cutting AI Chip Shipments
An already bad day for Broadcom got worse after a report that Alphabet Google has cut planned 2027 shipments of its custom chips developed in partnership with Broadcom by a million units.
